endpoint.grammar: One signed decimal value on the first completed line, compared by exact decimal value. In comparison tasks a valid number outside the displayed pair is an endpoint violation.
endpoint.completion: Observed newline or EOS within the generation budget
endpoint.decoding: Unrestricted greedy decoding with one beam

probe_design.fork_loss: full-vocabulary negative log probability of accepted next-token set
probe_design.A: Whole-answer contrastive loss against actual displayed rival; fixed layer 23, rank-one constrained synthesis.
probe_design.B: First-fork objective, fixed layer 23, rank-one update.
probe_design.C: First-fork objective, rank-one update on the frozen scan winner.
probe_design.D: First-fork objective with sampled decision-margin preservation on the same scan winner.
probe_design.E: Full-affine rank-four Adam baseline on complete accepted continuations. Train on fixed layer 23 for four steps, including matched correct preservation rows. Test the natural trained merge once if it meets the declared .35 realized norm cap.
probe_design.practice_gate: At least one additional target correct in both wordings, at least one correction from the frozen repeatable error set, no loss of valid outputs, and no regression of any previously correct practice presentation.
probe_design.duplicate_policy: Deduplicate identical rounded tensor states across arms. Report equivalent arms against the same full endpoint observation. Abstain on no-op or invalid numerical output.
probe_design.scope: Five arms, one primary probe per arm. Rank-one A through D share radii, target items, endpoint budget and stored update limits. Use matched full-generation practice guards and compare new checkpoints independently only after practice passes. Layer scan and conventional training have separately accounted compute.

candidate_lock: Each unique practice passer must survive a fresh-process selection reload with positive gain and zero prohibited regressions. Lock by highest selection gain, then lowest realized norm, then arm ID. Open hidden only for the locked finalist and parent. Require exact replay and rollback before any lineage eligibility.
